authority_architecture.private_transfer_authority_is_spent_exac: CONFIRMED. spawnGovernedSupervisorV4 performs the guard and the state transition SYNCHRONOUSLY in one microtask (NOT_TRANSFERRED -> TRANSFERRING) before any child creation, key export, pipe write or await; a second entrant gets ALREADY_TRANSFERRED. trust_model_honesty.stated_boundary: An inherited descriptor plus an ephemeral key establishes GOVERNED ROUTE PROOF across the detached process boundary: the key can only be written to a sink the authority module itself created, only one transfer can ever occur, and only the exact spawned process running the exact signed entrypoint can produce an acceptable acknowledgment. It is NOT claimed to provide complete operating-system isolation from all malicious same-user processes.
trust_model_honesty.advisor_search_for_stronger_claims: A targeted search across docs/contracts/LRCQ_ACTIVATION_V4_CONTRACT.md and every .foundergate/evidence/lrcq-assurance-factory/*.json for isolation / same-user / malicious / other-process / OS-level language found NO claim of operating-system isolation from same-user processes. The contract's strongest statement is scoped to key-material LOCATION - 'The key bytes exist only: briefly in the launcher's memory, in the kernel pipe buffer, and in the supervisor's memory inside the attach call. Never argv, environment, config JSON, disk, git, logs, receipts, stdout, or stderr' - which is a containment-of-route claim, not an isolation claim, and is accurate.
residual_risks_a_same_user_attacker_reta: A same-user process with debugger or memory-inspection privileges could in principle read the key from the launcher's or supervisor's address space, or from the kernel pipe buffer via the inherited descriptor of a process it controls. Nothing in this candidate claims otherwise.

The independent start-identity observation depends on /bin/ps being the genuine system binary at a fixed absolute path; a same-user attacker who can replace root-owned /bin/ps is outside this threat model, and the fs-authority guards' foreign-ownership properties are correctly recorded as SOURCE-PROVEN rather than as achieved runtime results.

The frozen provider binary is concurrently executed by the operator's own interactive Claude Code sessions on this host. That is the operator's tooling and outside the run route; it is disclosed in the Checker report and is not a defect of the candidate.
